title: Revision impact comparison
responsibility: Presents changed and affected units, recorded reasons, measurements and media for two revisions.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required media prefix for the paired gallery.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.base
inputs.description: Required comparison base or undefined. No base receives explicit guidance. Removed units come from this registry.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.head
inputs.description: Required selected revision supplying active units, reasons and records.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.client
inputs.description: Required source-comparison client used to derive compared sides when base exists. Failure falls back to null comparison data.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.selected
inputs.description: Required unit identifier or null, selecting a unit-detail panel when found.

inputs.name: HarnessCompare.onselect
inputs.description: Required callback for selecting impact-list or map units.

outputs.name: HarnessCompare
outputs.description: Impact groups and uncertainty/source explanations, reasons for directly touched units, before/after measured metrics and emitted sizes, media, dependency map and selected-unit detail. Removed units use base records/scenarios. Missing measurements stay unavailable.
